efficiency.metricNote: This run has no per-token price attached — a local model, a free quota, or a customer endpoint we are not billed for — so spend is reported in tokens. Tokens are what was actually measured; a dollar figure here would be invented.

environment.title: Streaming items must equal what the full parse would have built

funnel.note: The funnel is the primary reading of a run. Where a model stops says more than a single pass percentage does, especially at low N.

stages.label: Inspected
stages.meaning: Listed or read at least one file in the repository.

stages.label: Edited
stages.meaning: Wrote at least one file that actually changed on disk.

stages.label: Ran tests
stages.meaning: Invoked the visible-test tool at least once.

stages.label: Submitted
stages.meaning: Called submit, ending the rollout on its own terms.

harnessReview.law: a suspect examiner may not blame the model: verdict-bearing suspicion not cleared by in-record evidence withholds every model_fail in the run

definitions.groundingFailure: A file path the model wrote in its own reasoning that does not exist in the tree it was given, or that names a directory it is not allowed to see. Detected by matching source-file paths in the model's text against the agent box on disk — not by judging the prose.
definitions.nonexistent_path: The model named a source file that is not in the repository it was given. It was reasoning about a file that does not exist.
definitions.overclaim: The model stated the tests pass or the issue is fixed, and the independent hidden tests then failed. Counted per rollout: claimed-and-wrong, or not.
definitions.reReadChurn: How many times the model read a file it had already read in the same rollout. It is a cost and a coherence signal, not a failure: re-reading is sometimes right.
definitions.requested_hidden_path: The model named a path under the reference solution, the hidden grader or the hidden test directory. Those are not in its box; the request could not be served.

job.note: Job clock. This is the billable span of the run, not the sum of model latencies.

definitions.commandsRun: Shell commands executed inside the model's own container, against the command budget the contract declares. Only exams that advertise run_command have any.
definitions.deadEnds: Steps that moved nothing: a re-read, a repeat of the previous action, or a call to a tool this exam does not have. Counted, not judged.
definitions.hitStepLimit: Rollouts that ran out of steps without submitting. On a long task this is the number that separates 'could not finish' from 'finished wrong'.
definitions.revisits: Re-reads of a slice the rollout had already been given. On a long task, re-reading is how a model compensates for losing its own earlier context.
definitions.stepsUsed: Tool calls the rollout actually spent, out of the step limit the contract declares. A rollout that submitted early spent fewer, and that is a result, not a shortfall.

longHorizon.note: Counted off the recorded trace of each rollout. A dead end is a step that moved nothing: a re-read of a slice already returned, a repeat of the previous action, or a call to a tool this exam does not have.

models.billing: operator subscription, flat — not billed per token

note: Post-seal benchmark. It does not stamp any certifying gate and did not rewrite the exam, the gold solution, the grader or the certified evidence.

recordDigest.algorithm: sha256 over the record's canonical JSON (UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators) with recordDigest.sha256 set to 64 '0' characters

statistics.intervalNote: Wilson score interval, not the normal approximation. The normal approximation collapses to a zero-width interval at 0 successes, which would print a 0/2 run as '0%, certain'.
statistics.passAtKMethod: unbiased: pass@k = 1 - C(n-c, k) / C(n, k), for k <= n only
statistics.passAtKNote: pass@k is reported only for k up to the number of rollouts actually run. There is no pass@5 in a 2-rollout run.
